evidence.summary: Founded in 1952 and run in turn by the aviation industry ministries and the Aviation Industries of China until 1999, Nanchang Hangkong University describes itself as now co-built by the Jiangxi government and SASTIND.
It reports more than 400 national research projects, including military-industry (国防军工) projects, and says over 35% of its graduates go to work in aviation, aerospace and defence.
